主要内容: NOVAVAX INC entered into a collaboration and license agreement with SK bioscience Co., Ltd., granting SK bioscience exclusive rights to develop, manufacture, and commercialize NVX-CoV2373, its vaccine candidate for SARS-CoV-2, in South Korea. SK bioscience agreed to purchase a quantity of the finished vaccine product for early supply, contingent on regulatory approval. The company will supply the Matrix-M™ adjuvant to support the production of 40 million doses, which SK bioscience intends to sell to the Korean government. SK bioscience will pay tiered royalties in the low to middle double-digit range on vaccine sales in South Korea, net of agreed costs. SK bioscience is responsible for obtaining and maintaining regulatory approvals for the vaccine’s development, manufacture, and commercialization in South Korea, with reasonable support from NOVAVAX INC. The agreement will expire on the later of February 12, 2023, or the day the World Health Organization declares the end of the COVID-19 pandemic.
